description: This Java source file defines the class ModifyFeatureDefinitionStrategy, which handles the command for modifying or creating feature definitions within a Thing entity in the context of the Eclipse Ditto framework. It contains logic for extracting features from Things, generating modify or create events, and managing entity tags.

classes.name: ModifyFeatureDefinitionStrategy
classes.description: A strategy class that handles the modification or creation of feature definitions in a Thing within the Eclipse Ditto framework. Implements the logic to apply the command, extract features, and generate corresponding events.

methods.name: doApply
methods.description: Main method to process the ModifyFeatureDefinition command; modifies or creates feature definitions based on the current Thing state.

methods.name: extractFeature
methods.description: Helper method to extract the specific feature from the Thing based on the command's feature ID.

methods.name: getModifyOrCreateResult
methods.description: Determines whether to produce a modify or create result based on the feature's current definition presence.

methods.name: getModifyResult
methods.description: Constructs a result representing a feature definition modification, including the event and response.

methods.name: getCreateResult
methods.description: Constructs a result representing a new feature definition creation, including the event and response.

methods.name: previousEntityTag
methods.description: Provides the previous entity tag for concurrency control, based on the existing feature definition.

methods.name: nextEntityTag
methods.description: Provides the new entity tag after modification, based on the new feature definition.
